request_summary: Close the two CI gaps the review found: the matrix job never runs the new catalog validator's test, and no CI step exercises the hook runner the local gate depends on.
rationale: C2: bounded one-way door: deploy:.github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, deploy:.github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, deploy:declared:deployment — reduced-pipeline floor for ≤3 files in one real package; pipeline reach: no pipeline seat may edit .github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, so a pipeline lane could never finish this change — it is routed to the root session that ran this triage (or to the operator for any edit the root session's own grants refuse) and the handling is inline; the class above still states the change's weight (1 edit-target files / 0 package(s) (root pseudo-package excluded, Q1 2026-08-21) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=brownfield)
done_oracle: The macOS/Windows matrix job runs scripts/validate-catalog-test.js in its node --test block, and the job verifies the hook runner can actually run via --require-bash instead of leaving run-hook-tests.js unexercised.

seam_claims.note: The matrix job's last node --test entry; the new test file goes after it.

no_single_gate_reason: A GitHub Actions workflow has no local runner; GitHub's parser validates it at push. The runner the new step calls is verified by executing both of its branches locally.
